The '''bonfire''' is a small permanent [[fire]] burning at the [[Wintertodt Camp]].

==Trivia==
* The bonfire is a reference to [[wikipedia:Dark Souls|Dark Souls]], where they serve as checkpoints within the game.
* Esther is possibly a reference to an NPC in Dark Souls II found in Majula.
